title: ForkGRPO: Efficient Exploration and Fine-Grained Credit Assignment for Diffusion Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2610.19408v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Diffusion large language models (dLLMs) have advanced rapidly, yet strengthening their reasoning through reinforcement learning (RL) remains an open challenge. Any-order generation can suffer from entropy degradation, which narrows the reasoning paths available for exploration. Recent work mitigates this issue by applying standard GRPO with left-to-right generation. However, independently generating every rollout from the input prompt can leave alternative continuations from intermediate states underexplored, while trajectory-level advantages assign uniform credit to all tokens without distinguishing the contributions of individual reasoning segments. We propose ForkGRPO, an RL framework that couples efficient exploration with fine-grained segment-level credit assignment. translated_title: ForkGRPO：面向扩散语言模型的高效探索与细粒度信用分配
translated_abstract: 扩散大语言模型（dLLMs）发展迅速，然而通过强化学习（RL）增强其推理能力仍然是一个悬而未决的挑战。任意顺序生成可能会遭受熵退化问题，这会缩窄可供探索的推理路径。近期工作通过将标准GRPO与从左到右的生成方式相结合来缓解这一问题。然而，从输入提示独立生成每个rollout，会使来自中间状态的其他续写方式得不到充分探索，同时轨迹级别的优势分配对所有token赋予统一信用，无法区分各个推理片段的不同贡献。我们提出ForkGRPO，这是一个将高效探索与细粒度片段级信用分配相结合的强化学习框架。它沿着参考轨迹从高熵中间状态采样多个续写，优先考虑文本边界并复用共享前缀。
tldr: 提出ForkGRPO强化学习框架，通过从参考轨迹的高熵中间状态分支采样多个续写实现高效探索，并引入细粒度的片段级信用分配，从而提升扩散语言模型的推理能力。
en_tdlr: ForkGRPO is an RL framework that couples efficient exploration—sampling multiple continuations from high-entropy intermediate states along a reference trajectory—with fine-grained segment-level credit assignment for diffusion language models.
